notes.title: On July 12th, the vampire horror strikes!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3016090/_/

"The first vampire-themed game of the 'The Exit 8' genre will debut on July 12th. The experience of finding differences within the vampire's castle will bring you a fresh and exciting gameplay adventure.
Remember during gameplay, fear can strike at any moment."

notes.title: Trailer aktualisieren
notes.content:
Thank you for your support. We are about to update a version to address the following issues.
1. In PC mode, the lens may experience black occlusion.
2. When starting in PC mode, Steam VR will start, which reduces the issue of device performance.
3. Bugs in some games lead to abnormal issues.
Once the new version is approved, we will immediately release it. Thank you again.

notes.title: VR is supported
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863499/a4a37d722c19fa093eb4e30005aad5d7e40af41f.png[/img]
VR is supported. Switch to VR: Press ESC to call out menu and select VR Mode
Before switching, please make sure you have streamed your headset to the PC.
Before switching, please make sure you can take off headset at anytime.
After switching, you may never take it off again....
